title: Requesting the ability to group wallpapers into albums from the wallpaper image plugin
line: The Image wallpaper picker can now group wallpapers into albums and show just one album at a time.
explanation: The Image wallpaper picker only showed one flat, alphabetical list of every wallpaper, with no way to group them by theme. The image backend now keeps named albums in plasmarc ([Wallpaper Albums], one list of wallpaper paths per album, shared by every Image wallpaper and the lock screen's image settings). The header of the image grid gets an album menu (All Images, each album, New Album…, Delete Album…) that filters the grid, and each wallpaper gets an "Add to Album" button with a checkable list of albums and New Album….

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: let users group wallpapers into albums

With many wallpapers it was hard to find the ones for a given theme, as
the picker only showed one long list. Each wallpaper now has an "Add to
Album" button, and the header can switch between all images and albums.

BUG: 515293

media.caption: Master: the Image wallpaper picker has one flat list and no way to group wallpapers
With the change: the header's album menu lists All Images, the user's albums, New Album… and Delete Album…
Master: every wallpaper is always shown together
The "Nature" album selected: only its two wallpapers are shown
Master: a wallpaper's hover buttons only offer Open Containing Folder
New "Add to Album" hover button: checkable album list plus New Album…; Altai picked and applied from inside the album

review.text: It works as shown, but it is a sizeable new UI concept (header album menu, a new hover button on every wallpaper, two dialogs, shared storage in plasmarc) added to a wish no maintainer or VDG has weighed in on, so it needs a design agreement before an MR. Technically, user-typed album names are used directly as KConfig keys, which breaks with characters like '[', ']' or '=' and with leading/trailing spaces, and the album filter is a JS filterRowCallback in QML that touches the same sortedWallpaperModel as the 515292 fix, so the two will conflict.
changes: Raise the design on the bug or with VDG first (where album selection and membership live, whether a per-wallpaper hover button is acceptable).
Store albums in a safe structure, e.g. one subgroup per album with Name and Images entries, instead of using the user's name as a config key.
Move the album filtering into the C++ model layer of the image plugin and coordinate it with the 515292 filter so both use one mechanism.
